notes.title: The Burst update 1.0.42 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
Greetings operatives! The Burst update 1.0.42 is finally live! 

We got a bunch of cool stuff for you! What kinds of stuff, exactly, you might ask?
Well, many of you were waiting for them, and THEY FINALLY ARRIVED!
The highlights of our show... give a round of applause tooooo...
[h2]SPRINT BUTTON and JUMP BUTTON! Woooo![/h2]
We have also brought you a whole ton of weapon updates, movement fixes, and we have also eradicated a bunch of those pesky bugs that have been roaming around Damag! As always, if you're interested in the whole list of changes, read them down below!

[list]
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[*]Fixed voice recorders initial state
[*]Fixed Sniper Ratata sometimes becoming jammed, requiring multiple rebolts
[*]Fixed Sniper Ratata model and its LODs
[*]Fixed scope sizes and colors to improve visibility
[*]Reworked SAP energy mechanism, now it works correctly. Nova's special SAP now fires after trigger pull and not release
[*]Reworked flamethrower sound
[*]General weapon handling and performance improvements
[*]General weapon mesh and animation improvements
[*]Fixed ammo drop rate chance
[*]Balance tweaks to all the weapons
[*]Fixed stuttering when walking over small elevations
[*]Improved ammo drop chance for supply boxes
[*]Increased vehicle suspension haptics treshold to reduce constant bumping when dirivng over rough terrain
[*]Implemented stability graph for compound constructions to prevent parts from floating in air when their base is broken
[*]Improved vehicle damage to compound constructions
[*]Imporoved hammer prop handling
[*]Fixed stick crouching option not working
[*]Added stick-sprint option to toggle sprinting by clicking on movement stick
[*]Fixed flamethrower not having any sound on android platform
[*]Increased jump height from sliding
[*]Simplified jump code, now player can jump in any direction
[*]Added easy jump option which removes need to swing hands to jump higher
[*]Improved enemies grenade throwing behavior. Now enemies won't throw grenades in close proximity to themselves and other allies
[*]Fixed Boom-Rifle and Revolver mags not displaying correct ammo count
[*]Fixed mag duplication when ejecting a mag, putting it on a belt and taking it back to refill
[*]Fixed enemies aiming incorrectly
[*]Fixed subtitles showing incorrectly in certain dialogues
[*]Improved AI reloading behavior

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
[*]Disabled Round-Robin occlusion queries
[*]Fixed vehicle animation occasionally misplacing wheels
[*]Fixed missing overlays on smooth spectator (PC)
[*]Smooth spectator now renders projection from user's eye, rather than center of the HMD

[h1]Levels[/h1]
[*]Optimized crowded ending scene
[*]Fixed visibility issues of objects that are under crane at Lead Lair
[*]Fixed incorrect precomputed visibility and streaming at Lead Lair
[*]Fixed background objects at Lead Lair
[*]Improved performance on Mobile platforms at Forgepolis
[*]Fixed misplaced LOD placeholders at prologue
[*]Fixed toilet lid cover position in prologue
[*]Fixed tutorial interruption logic
[*]Fixed Varg hooks clipping through objects
[*]Fixed some tape locations in Landing Zone
[*]Improved audio volume levels in Bordergate
[*]Fixed some precomputed visibility issues at various locations
[*]Fixed some breakable constructions in Bordergate
[*]Improved ending scene performance
[*]Fixed player softlocking by leaving Varg's elevators
[*]Fixed player falling through Varg's elevator roof when extensively jumping
[*]Fixed Varg's elevator going back
[*]Fixed lighting issues at Bunker
[*]Fixed visibility and lighting issues at Forgepolis
[*]Fixed Techkiller bosses spawn logic
[*]Redesigned checkpoints and fall triggers at The Wall level
[*]Fixed collision issues on cave supports
[*]Fixed fog blending inside Bunker's vents
[*]Fixed incorrect lightmap behaviour at train levels
[*]Fixed reflection probes and, culling and collision at Bordergate
[*]Fixed object culling at Leadlair
 
[h1]Menu[/h1]
[*]Fixed menu scroll direction inputs

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[*]Fixed dry fire clicks having no attenuation

[h1]Localization[/h1]
[*]Fixed localization of the  driving tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: The Burst version 1.0.32 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings operatives![/h1]

I come bearing great news! We now have full bHaptics support!
That's right! Now you can feel everything that poor Hornet feels! Getting shot, falling into the abyss, blowing up, crashing your mirage into a ton of explosives! Sounds like an amazing experience! Right?

Oh, and by the way, there's a whoooole lot of other things we cooked with this new version! One of those things are... ACHIEVEMENTS!!! That's right, they're finally here! Also we've done some requested enemy improvements and much, [i]MUCH[/i] more!

Anyways, im sure you're curious about what exacrlty we did and what feedback we implemented, so here's a full list of everything!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Armor debris collision is fixed — the player can no longer stand on armor pieces
[*] ACHIEVEMENTS
[*] Enemy accuracy is now range-dependent
[*] Enemies now react faster if they lose sight of the player
[*] Enemies now play turn animations correctly
[*] Several climbing issues were fixed
[*] Elevator buttons now have better visibility and differ in color
[*] The player’s hand no longer disappears when reloading a save with a weapon in hand
[*] The climbing is now more stable
[*] Varg’s hooks are now easier to access
[*] Syringes no longer affect cutscenes and their buffs are removed before the cutscene starts
[*] Enemy troops are now more mobile
[*] Enemy accuracy now depends on the player’s mobility — increases for standing targets, decreases for moving targets
[*] Enemy recoil is now both vertical and horizontal
[*] Actions leading to enemies dying are now registered correctly
[*] Several enemy animations were updated
[*] Several issues related to hook-dash ability were resolved
[*] The final boss now properly stops before dying
[*] Health and armor values for bosses underwent balance changes
[*] Enemy fire rate was rebalanced
[*] Enemies no longer yeet themselves to space after jumping
[*] Heavy enemies now have their jogging animation fixed
[*] Some enemies were mistakenly unhookable before. Not anymore.
[*] Melee enemies that can push now look for cover if the player is unreachable
[*] Took away teleportation tricks from enemies. Now they jump over obstacles properly.
[/list]

[h2]Level Art[/h2]

[list]
[*] Several annoying broken collisions, fog and flying objects were fixed in the Bunker mission
[*] Fixed distance culling of some meshes at Leadlair
[*] Missing gameplay sublevel in the Bunker mission is now restored
[*] Prologue underwent some minor fixes
[*] Cull distances at Bordergate now work better
[*] Track Owner no longer talks to the player after you escape the track
[*] Light mobility at Forgepolis was improved
[*] Proxies at Bordergate now work properly
[/list]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]

[list]
[*] FBAR magazine LODs were fixed
[*] Upgrade case now has better interior textures, its visibility was significantly improved
[*] SFX/VFX
[*] Flying enemy VFXs are now smoother
[/list]

[h2]Bhaptics[/h2]

[list]
[*] Landing (a slight vibration at the bottom of the torso)
[*] Wind (on the vehicles too!)
[*] Sliding along the floor (back haptics activation)
[*] Grabbing objects and surfaces
[*] Shooting
[*] Hook swinging and release haptics (depends on overall hook stress when swinging)
[*] Inventory interactions (belt and back slots)
[*] Taking damage from bullets, explosions and melee attacks
[*] Falling into the abyss (vibration all over the suit)
[*] Death (vibration all over the suit)
[*] Low health (heartbeat)
[*] Mirage engine start
[*] Running something ([i]or someone[/i]) over and crashing
[*] Front and back mirage suspension bumping
[/list]

That is going to be all for now, operatives. Stay tuned, something's coming ;)

notes.title: VISUAL UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE
notes.content:
[h1]Operatives![/h1]

I’m pleased to finally announce that the [b]Visual Update[/b] for [b]THE BURST[/b] is now [b]LIVE[/b]!

Hope you didn’t have to wait for too long! To sweeten the pill a 25% discount is available starting today, [b]October 4th, 10 AM PDT[/b] and will last for 14 days!

As we promised, almost every aspect of the game was enhanced in one way or another: gameplay, level art, graphics and effects!

We also delivered on our other promise - [b]THE UPDATED DEMO FOR THE BURST WILL GO LIVE TODAY[/b] just a bit later, hour-two most.

Jump on your Mirage, greet Shelldogs with rapid fire as they finally leave the Damag rehab center and touch THE NEW AND IMPROVED WALL!

Bug fixes, bot behavior improvements, lots of environmental detailing, but that is not all.

The Burst now supports [b]bHaptics[/b]! Even more immersion for an epic postapocalyptic experience! We will be adding more events to the already existing list in upcoming patches. Feel free to send your feedback to us!

Unfortunately, the long-awaited achievements will have to wait a little bit… They are almost here, but as some of them require a bit more tuning, we will be sure to add them over the course of the next week.

Check us out and don’t forget to [u][b]leave a review[/b][/u] so we could work even harder and make the game even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/52ccd7a760bc48d11d54918d664cd89987ac0c55.png[/img]

For those of you curious enough, here is our full changelog:

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

-Flying enemies are now more precise
-Shelldogs no longer fall off containers in Utopia’s lair
-Subtitles no longer fade if the line goes on but the scene changes
-Hornet’s comments on his own decisions now correspond to the path he took
-Ghouls’ animations were tweaked
-Player now respawns correctly if they die/fall while driving Mirage
-Enemies learned how to jump properly
-Armored enemies can now be spiked
-Machinegunners now show a bit more of common sense in combat
-Enemies no longer get stuck when spawned
-Machinegunners, snipers and basic shooters passed their ballistic training and now target the player properly
-Scientists no longer  freeze in strange poses (being scared is not a valid excuse, old man!)
-Ladders are now easier to climb
-Enemies are no longer indecisive if they are too close for shooting and too far for melee
-Fixed rigor mortis causing guns to stick to enemies’ hands and turning them into ragdolls
-Armored enemies now have their both feet firmly on the ground
-Game no longer crashes when you try to hook an object
-Enemies now stand up properly
-Enemies passed their grade school exams with flying colors
-Some enemies had their armor rebalanced
-Crane position is now displayed properly
-Enemies are no longer airwalking if the tile underneath was broken
-Jumping tutorial was updated
-Boomsquad DMR “Spiker” was added to the arsenal (UCE archives don’t have info on it yet, but we will add it soon)
-Enemies now use cover more efficiently
-Mags and props no longer appear frozen
-Mirage wheels are now more stable and won’t jump randomly
-Mirage no longer spawns locked
-Flashbacks no longer corrupt save files
-Enemies now properly support their gun with their left hand
-Grenades now work as intended
-Items no longer spawn outside of boxes assigned to them
-Yellow box debris no longer prevents the player from taking the contents of the said box
-Items retain their velocity when the player is in motion and throws it
-Bosses now properly traverse their arenas
-Enemies are now better at closing distance
-Crane shows improvement in behavior and pathfinding (it can smell you)
-Utopia now dies properly
-The player’s hands no longer tremble or collide in silly ways while reloading and running
-Flying enemies won’t try to use jetpacks if they were destroyed or disabled
-Snipers and flyboys now have their assigned armor
-Items no longer fly away if you hook them with two hands
-Breaking structures will no longer cause a crash
-Belt slot positioning was tweaked
-Player can no longer duplicate mags by stacking them in the belt

[h3]Level-art[/h3]

-Intro level streaming no longer causes lighting issues
-Level instances no longer unload too early
-Reflection probes are now updated
-Level LODs on multiple levels are now updated
-Intro sequence reflections, caves, background meshes and proxies on various levels show significant improvement
-General level art improvements - no more holes, flying objects or objects with broken collision
-Lighting, navigation and precomputed visibility were improved on many levels
-Train station level design was changed to add to fluidity of the boss battle. The train itself was slightly restructured.
-Bunker level art underwent some changes
-Leadlair cull distances were tweaked
-Burrowcamp level now can flex its ember and smoke particles
-The Wall level story scenes now activate properly
-Bordergate elevator puzzle now has an additional hint
-Smoke effects were integrated in The Wall level
-The carpet in Leadlair no longer bugs out
-Droppod textures are now updated (look for a cute new monitor to track your descent)
-Bordergate is now a windy place
-The Wall is now more detailed
-Road meshes were changed
-Road to the City enemy positioning is now a bit better
-Forgepolis background placeholders now apply properly
-Ending slides will now recognize correctly if [spoiler]Utopia[/spoiler] is dead or not
-Added more spots where enemies can jump and climb over obstacles
-Culling issues for Burrowcamp and Leadlair chapters were fixed

[h3]Graphics[/h3]

-Placeholders are no longer visible from the other side during streaming
-Utopia no longer has multiple pairs of eyes, that was freaky even for her
-General visual improvements on many levels, including but not limited to everything described in the previous passage. From Droppod to Bunker, a lot of textures are now more detailed
-Debris no longer flies too far away

[h3]SFX/VFX[/h3]

-Music no longer cuts off during the final cutscene of the first mission
-Distant effects now show proper sprite rotation
-Some bottles now have liquid
-Bottle shaders were also improved
-Bottles with liquid break with a distinct sound
-Grabbing now feels smoother
-Armor hit SFX is now more juicy
-Rocket trails on The Wall level have better visibility
-Entfant spores look a bit different now
-When bullets whoosh by your ear, you will hear it
-Varg soundtrack timings are now to the point
-Enemy footsteps sound even better now
-Sand shock wave effects for Leadlair, Train and The Wall scenes were enhanced.

[h3]General[/h3]

-[b]bHaptics[/b] is now supported!
-Peripherals and corresponding settings can be accessed through the menu
-New tutorials for breaking crates, activating grenades, opening upgrade boxes and pulling yourself to enemies are now added to the game
-New Era ending has its actors properly assigned
-Russian localization for prologue lever tutorial is now fixed

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES! Part 2!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! We've got great news! It's been a week since we shared the first part of our upcoming updates, and we're thrilled to announce that it's finally time for [b]PART 2[/b]!

Today, we're going to dive into...
[h1]VISUAL UPDATES![/h1]

Alright, alright, without further ado, let's jump right into it!

    [h2][b]The visual update itself! (already in the works)[/b][/h2]
[list]
[i]We are set on maintaining our visual style, however, the quantity and quality of expressive means will be significantly increased across all platforms. Visual improvement will [b]affect several locations not only from an aesthetical standpoint, but also in terms of gameplay experience[/b]. [/i]
[*] First and foremost it is the [b]player’s navigation[/b] that will be affected. As you might have noticed we tend to keep the interface clear of any unnecessary markers — for that reason we are planning to add native markers to help the player progress further.
[*] You can also expect the [b]weather events[/b] to have more impact both visually and audibly
[*] Some [b]boss arenas will be changed[/b] to favor gameplay aspects and test the player’s skills all the while reminding of learnt mechanics (basically how it works with the boss residing in Bordergate)
[*] [b]Boss AI[/b] will also adapt to these changes
[*] [b]The visual aspects of several story scenes[/b] will be sufficiently refined
[*] [b]Gameplay tutorials[/b] will be tweaked slightly, the same goes for several notes and tapes that will be changed to provide contextual tutorial (in case the player misses a UI-hint)
[*] [b]New visual effects[/b], both scenical and gameplay focused
[/list]

    [h2][b]Exciting additions (prior to the content patch)[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievements (plenty of them)
[*] Peripheral hardware (Bhaptics)
[*] We’ve also noticed that some players experience difficulties with our movement system. We are planning to[b] introduce several accessibility features[/b] that will allow our players to customize and simplify some of the mechanics.
[/list]

That's a wrap for today, everyone! We can't wait to see you on Damag for one of the most anticipated events: the visual update! ;)

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings operatives![/h2]

Let’s have a little talk about all the current milestones of our Roadmap for The Burst. You’ll see what our team is up to right now and what to expect in the upcoming months. It’s a bit more complicated than just “we are fixing things” and expands on the whole “visual update” we are planning for this beloved child of ours. This time we'll cover...

[h1]GENERAL TWEAKING AND TINKERING[/h1]

[h2]    [b]Critical bug fixes[/b]. Basically, what we were doing all this time anyway (and will keep on doing). That includes but isn’t limited to:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [i]Crashes, optimization stuttering, nasty visual and audio bugs.[/i]
[*] [i]Going out of bounds, misplaced kill volumes and soft-locks.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]    The [b]AI[/b] in general will go through a lot of fine-tuning. As its improvement will be gradual, you’ll see some of it first-hand even before the content patch rolls out. The improvements mentioned will address some enemy AI issues such as navigation and behavior:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Navigation[/b]: those of you who played our Demo might have noticed a downgrade in bot positioning and movement. The main reason for it is the seamless nature of the game — it utilizes a more complex navigational system than the standalone Demo/Prologue chapter. As of right now we are both fixing current navigation as it is and adding new pathing for bots to exclude any possibility of them getting stuck in a navigational bottleneck, so they could figure out optimal or alternative routes during the shootouts. All in all the upcoming changes will also affect enemy animations.
[*] [b]Behavior[/b]: Shelldogs (and other enemies) are currently in rehab after overdosing on entfant flesh. Enemy reactions to the player will be changed to match the bot’s role on the battlefield for them to coincide with a logical layout of their squad. In addition to fixing the AI’s indifference to the player, navigational mishaps and clumsy self-detonating grenadiers, we plan on making enemies more recognizable as members of their subclass. Right now it is common for players to not discern different types of enemies from one another. It will change in the near future, however — all enemies will have a class behavior pattern: shooters with a decent range will be less mobile and remain at advantageous positions, while assault units will force close quarters combat with the player. 
[/list]

    [h2]And one of the last, but not the least:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon rebalancing[/b] and improvements focusing on [b]Mirage fights[/b] (some of them you might have already noticed)
[*] [b]Hook targeting[/b] enhancement and swinging mechanic tweaking.
[/list]

That's going to be all for today! See you next time, where we'll look into the details of the [i]visual update[/i]! ;)

notes.title: The Burst Q&A
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings operatives.[/h1]

[h2]A week ago we started collecting questions to answer in our Q&A. 
You seem to know a lot about The Burst already, huh? Well, not all of you, so here are some answers:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Will there ever be free story dlc / paid content?[/b]
We are not planning any DLCs as separate 'downloadable content' yet.  But as you may know we are planning at least two new game modes, which are still under wraps, although I'm pretty sure we'll have something to show you soon enough ;)

[*][b]What was your scariest moment when the game released?[/b]
It wasn't particularly scary, more like very... embarrassing. We couldn't bring the game to its desired state in the given time.

[*][b]When jump button?[/b]
We have heard your request and added it to the list of features requested by players. We can't say exactly when we'll be able to implement it, but rest assured, we remember about it <3

[*][b]What was the most difficult thing during the development?[/b]
Development in itself isn't easy, especially when work as a team. People need to be guided in the right direction, you have to acknowledge the limits you can push your project to. 
Some features require a lot of time and effort and the AI… Don't even get me started on it.

[*][b]Who is the woman you play as in the prologue?[/b]
Nova is a rebel who comes from one of the UCE unruly colonies. Her role is to show the player the hook and jet-belt capabilities that "K" kindly provides her with. You'll see her at Bordergate though.

[*][b]How many unique endings are there?[/b]
There are 6 of them. Or 4 if you don't take variations into account. However, even variations have their own afterscene and monologue, so in my mind it counts as a legitimate ending.
[strike][i]No spoilers though ;)[/i][/strike]

[*][b]Could the game`s setting be considered grimdark, and will there be lore of what is outside the prison planet?[/b]
There is some lore indicating it, but you will have to look around to find out the exact details, as well as some social and political homages.

[*][b]Can you tell us a little bit more on the lore/ the world order in the game?[/b]
The colony planet Damag experienced an all-out nuclear war about 40 years ago. It hasn’t recovered since, but considering that Damag is the only planet where people can mine a resource called Amplinium, something had to be done. So the United Coalition of Earth turned Damag into a penal colony planet. Convicts are sent here indefinitely to mine resources and trade them for food, water and other supplies. Saying that the universe itself experienced an apocalypse isn’t right. The planet did. And you will bear witness to the consequences of human greed.
[/list]

And that's going to be all for today, operatives. 
See you later!

notes.title: Future plans and upcoming news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/324bbfdc8cb5b2348c4d453a214b0580d6dd5ac7.jpg[/img]

[h2]Greetings agent.[/h2]
[h3]Perhaps its time to talk a bit about what [b]The Burst[/b] has in store for you.[/h3]

I am sure that by now you all are very familiar with our dynamic immersive movement and parkour systems...

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3Z3NW5kbXIxZTJhdHI2cDF4YWF1bXhvb2d3cGtiYXN1OHNnc3NjNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/fka2EWV5uInNl0N8Iv/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

...or with our extensive arsenal of cool guns to shred your enemies with. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdWFseGxjZGJmbDJibWVrcnRpaXN5ejJrbDJ0dDd4NGFxMjhsdDBlYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hcuDiXEg4935SnHtB5/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

But did you know that we actually have several different endings? An interesting plot with mysteries, flashbacks to the past and drama?

Well, guess what? Not so long ago we announced our release date, which is on 08.08, if you missed it.
Now we bring you... [b]Price and discounts![/b] That's right folks, [b]The Burst[/b] is going to cost [b]$29.99[/b] on steam (dont forget the regional pricing!), and will get a [b]10% off[/b] discount on release! Dont miss your chance! Grab it while you can!

Our team thought its time to share our plans for the future of [b]The Burst[/b]. 

Fear not, we are not leaving any time soon after release, because we are planning on supporting our game for at least half a year, and we have lots of cool stuff in store for you!

[i]But what cool stuff, guys?[/i] - you may ask. [b]New and exciting game modes![/b] I can't tell you a lot about them for now, buuuut... 

Stay tuned!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/dbdf2a0f4625cb208094c0e1cea349cbd2b77038.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents![/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Today we are going to talk about Mirage - our amazing vehicle that you will use to traverse the sands of Damag. Or rather, about one of its functions.[/b][/h3]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExanJqZmFoMmdxdjJtNXNnbmE0YzFwY281enp3cWZoNGN1Z2w5djczciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/UGvjH9aNnMOBSFq0fH/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]The beast itself[/i]

To be completely clear, we're going to talk about something that's actually been [i]missing[/i]. 
Of course, I'm talking about shooting.

Beforehand, your only option was to ride your Mirage into the sunset, and maybe bump into your enemies and hope for the best.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExM3gwMGZudWl0bnJmNW8yOWI1aDMzd2NzdWEydjYzbm9mazBkZ3k0ZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3J2Z83THYUBvlU3joh/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]How do you like that!?[/i]

But we had our [i]top men[/i] working on it for seven billion years and the results speak for themselves:

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExejY0Nzc0NTdibGdhbjF3c3lucWllaXNzODJwNm9udjgwNWg0OHdsbyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/rlpUYT9wh27qgoM5e9/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Look at him go![/i]

As a bonus, I'll show you an alternative solution that we were preparing. Feast your eyes upon the Mirage with... guns!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/05d4f67f60274de5368ebdb5a38d206d80ffe219.png[/img][i]Work in progress[/i]

That will be all for today. See you soon ːB1ː

notes.title: Demo Patch #1 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]Player Character[/h2]
- You can run on more walls now.
- The animation for standing up after landing on the high ground became smoother.
- You can now lean over objects.
- Objects are easier to grab now.
- You are less likely to slip after landing on the edge of a platform.
- Removed two of Nova's voicelines in the last section of the demo

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
- Improved CPU performance for the grappling hook.
- Improved CPU performance for explosive barrel VFX.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- The demo now uses DirectX 12 (Shader Model 6) instead of DirectX 11.

[h2]Interactions[/h2]
- Fixed some grappling hook interactions with levers, rings and hooks.
- Broken props and joints will no longer stay attached to the grappling hook.
- Chipper (enemy secondary weapon) has several new grip positions.
- Supply crates are now easier to break.
- Rope physics are more stable and predictable.

[h2]Input[/h2]
- Added an option to toggle the grip button for climbing and grabbing.
- Made it harder to trigger false grip on Index Controllers.
- Increased the slide window before landing after falling from great height.
- Menu can now be accessed by pressing the Right Menu on HTC Vive.
- You can now Jump by pressing the Right Trackpad Down on HTC Vive.
- You can now eject a magazine by pressing the Right Trackpad Up on HTC Vive
- Fixed a visual bug that affected “Controls” menu input for HTC Vive Controllers.
- Fixed a bug when a grappling hook would activate randomly while swinging.

[h2]Level Design[/h2]
- Certain pits or falls will trigger your death properly now.
- Parkour sections before the hideout received some visual improvement.
- Mirage (vehicle) won’t get stuck on the ramp before the hideout.
- Some cave textures were redesigned.
- Several minor visual bugs were fixed.

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
- Several tutorial videos were tweaked. Removed the sound of the tutorial window closing.
- The currently active tutorial will not affect other tutorials anymore.
- Added a line describing the Turn Mode in the tutorial.

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
- Only staggered enemies can now be thrown on spikes.
- Enemies will now properly follow the player’s position.
- Enemies will now become aggressive after being hit with a weapon in melee.
- Minor AI improvements.
- Enemies will no longer die when their armor piece falls into a pit.
- Improved the AI logic for the last segment of the game. Drivers got their license.
- Enemies no longer get stuck on one of the arenas.
- Enemies now reach for their holster before equipping a new weapon.
- Added SFX and VFX when enemies get spiked.
- Added additional SFX for enemies receiving damage in melee.

Liked the trailer? Then please share it with others and leave a comment on YouTube, it will help us a lot! Thanks!

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073880/The_Burst/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/df105df5a12f597c6cfa099388e3dadc01718a1d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents![/b][/h2]
[h3][b]The Steam Next Fest has finally arrived! And that means only one thing — The Burst demo is live too![/b][/h3]

So why are you still reading this?! 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073880/The_Burst/]💥 DOWNLOAD THE DEMO RIGHT HERE 💥[/url][/b]

But if you just found The Burst through Steam and have no idea what to expect, let us explain what's going on!

The Burst is a single-player VR FPS set in a far away dystopian world.
The game focuses a lot on fast-paced movement, snappy gunplay and interactive environments. We also have a reverse trike and a grappling hook (you can read more about it [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2073880/view/6200946357159550980?l=english]here[/url][/b])!

Our demo version is not just cut content from the main game. We're offering you a special side story complete with a [b]new location[/b], a [b]different protagonist[/b] and a [b]whole new adventure[/b].

We put a lot of effort into this demo, so we sincerely hope you enjoy it!
And please don't forget to record your playthroughs and and share 'em with us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/ABkxTAQkPQ]Discord[/url][/b], [b][url=https://twitter.com/Gorapid_Studio]Twitter[/url][/b], or [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2073880/discussions/]Steam[/url][/b]. We really want to see how we can improve our game even further, so you'd be helping us out a lot!

You can also use this [b][url=https://forms.gle/Wm8tzTjYSrTy7mGt7]Feedback Survey[/url][/b] and tell us about your experience! If you have a recorded video, please include it with your response.

Thank you for trying our demo and until next time! ːB1ː

notes.title: Mirage
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/904aa0276c1b8d4fcb7ab60b17c46fd863336ed9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents.[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Wanna see something cool and exciting?[/b][/h3]

Let me introduce you to our [b]Mirage![/b]
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYjRuMGF4emlsMGcwNGxzam1pZHF2MXcycHRsejRyazRsN2VoNGk4diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YgieUyOZEXNHKLIkMf/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]A reverse trike? In my VR game?![/i]


In the world of The Burst, you may often find yourself in a situation where you need to get somewhere fast. That's where the Mirage comes in.
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMW5ia2l6NWFqeXdycWt0Y3g1ZWJncnNxNW5peGF4b3VsdzU5OGR4cSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/nYm9Q0avdtCki89qLa/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]A hairpin turn? No problem![/i]


Hop on and enjoy the ride at the speed of light!
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaWFuMmRnaGQxNWdwd24zdDBsdGlyM3FnMXIzMDhjazFnM252NGZydyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/qrJCAYfj8XaT8HxnJY/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Or maybe just around 70 km/h.[/i]


Enjoy the apocalyptic views of a civilization long gone.
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/YMiUra6rllrOCYumwg/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]The ruins in the distance! I wonder if they got any loot.[/i]


Or just use it to blow up some red barrels for style points. The choice is yours!
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/4bxDRGlZ9Z3ztLkxP2/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Not actually recommended to do, but who am I to stop you.[/i]

That's all about Mirage for today.
Until next time! :B1:
